rationale: isFixedTextOnlyUpdate is the host-config gate that lets a text-only prop change skip a full re-apply. It only recognised a node whose height was pinned outright, so an element sized by a fixed line-height -- the ordinary shape for a single-line label -- fell through the gate and paid a full re-apply on every text change, which is exactly the per-keystroke cost the gate exists to avoid. The gate now also accepts a fixed line height: hasFixedLineHeight() takes a positive number or a bare/px string and deliberately rejects percentages, `normal` and zero, because none of those pin a box height. Two escapes keep it honest. TEXT_DELEGATING (button, Button, TextEditor) is excluded because those types hand their text to a child label, so the parent's own line height does not determine the measured box; and hasLineClamp() (lineClamp, WebkitLineClamp, webkitLineClamp) excludes clamped text, where the box is multi-line and a line height no longer fixes it. whiteSpace must still be nowrap and the width must still be fixed, so wrapping text is unaffected. render-assets-and-backends is crossed only because packages/pulp-react/** sits under its selector. No renderer, backend, GPU surface, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no fixture, snapshot or threshold moves. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
